sql: SELECT status, count() FROM article GROUP BY status;
SELECT id, title, desk, status FROM article WHERE status = 'c_11' OR status = 'c_23';
SELECT id, article, kind, text FROM brief WHERE text CONTAINS 'kill' OR text CONTAINS 'Kill' OR text CONTAINS 'pull' OR text CONTAINS 'publication';
SELECT id, status, body FROM article WHERE status = 'c_11' OR status = 'c_23';
SELECT id, article, kind, created_at, text FROM brief WHERE article IN [article:a12, article:a19, article:a28, article:a33, article:a41, article:a5, article:a7];
SELECT id, title, desk, status, published_at FROM article WHERE title NOT CONTAINS 'desk report';
SELECT id, title, desk, status, published_at FROM article WHERE title !~ 'desk report';
SELECT id, parent, content FROM passage WHERE parent IN [article:a12, article:a19, article:a28, article:a33, article:a41, article:a5, article:a7]; SELECT id, heading, body FROM factbox;
